items.statement: Establish and follow written procedures describing the in-process controls, tests or examinations to be performed on appropriate samples of in-process materials from each batch, to assure batch uniformity and drug product integrity.
items.quote: To assure batch uniformity and integrity of drug products, written procedures shall be established and followed that describe the in-process controls, and tests, or examinations to be conducted on appropriate samples of in-process materials of each batch.

items.statement: Establish in-process control procedures that monitor the output and validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may cause variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.
items.quote: Such control procedures shall be established to monitor the output and to validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may be responsible for causing variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.

items.statement: Where appropriate, include tablet or capsule weight variation in the in-process control procedures.
items.quote: Tablet or capsule weight variation;

items.statement: Where appropriate, include disintegration time in the in-process control procedures.
items.quote: Disintegration time;

items.statement: Where appropriate, include checks of mixing adequacy to assure uniformity and homogeneity in the in-process control procedures.
items.quote: Adequacy of mixing to assure uniformity and homogeneity;

items.statement: Where appropriate, include dissolution time and rate in the in-process control procedures.
items.quote: Dissolution time and rate;

items.statement: Where appropriate, include clarity, completeness or pH of solutions in the in-process control procedures.
items.quote: Clarity, completeness, or pH of solutions.

items.statement: Where appropriate, include bioburden testing in the in-process control procedures.
items.quote: Bioburden testing.

items.statement: Ensure valid in-process specifications are consistent with final drug product specifications, are derived from previous acceptable process average and process variability estimates where possible, and are determined using suitable statistical procedures where appropriate.
items.quote: Valid in-process specifications for such characteristics shall be consistent with drug product final specifications and shall be derived from previous acceptable process average and process variability estimates where possible and determined by the application of suitable statistical procedures where appropriate.

items.statement: Ensure examination and testing of samples assures that in-process material and the drug product conform to specifications.
items.quote: Examination and testing of samples shall assure that the drug product and in-process material conform to specifications.

items.statement: Test in-process materials for identity, strength, quality and purity as appropriate, and have the quality control unit approve or reject them during production, for example at the start or end of significant phases or after long storage.
items.quote: In-process materials shall be tested for identity, strength, quality, and purity as appropriate, and approved or rejected by the quality control unit, during the production process, e.g., at commencement or completion of significant phases or after storage for long periods.

items.statement: Identify rejected in-process materials and control them under a quarantine system designed to prevent their use in manufacturing or processing operations for which they are unsuitable.
items.quote: Rejected in-process materials shall be identified and controlled under a quarantine system designed to prevent their use in manufacturing or processing operations for which they are unsuitable.

not_applicable.text: § 211.110 Sampling and testing of in-process materials and drug products.

items.statement: When appropriate, establish time limits for completing each phase of production to assure drug product quality.
items.quote: When appropriate, time limits for the completion of each phase of production shall be established to assure the quality of the drug product.

items.statement: A deviation from established production time limits may be accepted if it does not compromise drug product quality.
items.quote: Deviation from established time limits may be acceptable if such deviation does not compromise the quality of the drug product.

items.statement: Justify and document any deviation from established production time limits.
items.quote: Such deviation shall be justified and documented.

items.statement: Establish and follow appropriate written procedures designed to prevent objectionable microorganisms in drug products not required to be sterile.
items.quote: Appropriate written procedures, designed to prevent objectionable microorganisms in drug products not required to be sterile, shall be established and followed.

items.statement: Establish and follow appropriate written procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile.
items.quote: Appropriate written procedures, designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile, shall be established and followed.

items.statement: Include validation of all aseptic and sterilization processes in the procedures for preventing microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile.
items.quote: Such procedures shall include validation of all aseptic and sterilization processes.

items.statement: Establish and follow written procedures prescribing a system for reprocessing batches that do not conform to standards or specifications, including the steps to ensure reprocessed batches conform with all established standards, specifications and characteristics.
items.quote: Written procedures shall be established and followed prescribing a system for reprocessing batches that do not conform to standards or specifications and the steps to be taken to insure that the reprocessed batches will conform with all established standards, specifications, and characteristics.

items.statement: Do not reprocess without review and approval by the quality control unit.
items.quote: Reprocessing shall not be performed without the review and approval of the quality control unit.

items.statement: Have and follow written procedures describing in sufficient detail the receipt, identification, storage, handling, sampling, examination and/or testing of labeling and packaging materials.
items.quote: There shall be written procedures describing in sufficient detail the receipt, identification, storage, handling, sampling, examination, and/or testing of labeling and packaging materials; such written procedures shall be followed.

items.statement: Representatively sample labeling and packaging materials and examine or test them on receipt and before use in packaging or labeling a drug product.
items.quote: Labeling and packaging materials shall be representatively sampled, and examined or tested upon receipt and before use in packaging or labeling of a drug product.

items.statement: Labeling or packaging materials that meet appropriate written specifications may be approved and released for use.
items.quote: Any labeling or packaging materials meeting appropriate written specifications may be approved and released for use.

items.statement: Reject labeling or packaging materials that do not meet their written specifications, to prevent their use in operations for which they are unsuitable.
items.quote: Any labeling or packaging materials that do not meet such specifications shall be rejected to prevent their use in operations for which they are unsuitable.

items.statement: Keep records for each shipment received of each different labeling and packaging material showing receipt, examination or testing, and whether it was accepted or rejected.
items.quote: Records shall be maintained for each shipment received of each different labeling and packaging material indicating receipt, examination or testing, and whether accepted or rejected.

items.statement: Store labels and other labeling materials separately, with suitable identification, for each different drug product, strength, dosage form or quantity of contents.
items.quote: Labels and other labeling materials for each different drug product, strength, dosage form, or quantity of contents shall be stored separately with suitable identification.

items.statement: Limit access to the labeling storage area to authorized personnel.
items.quote: Access to the storage area shall be limited to authorized personnel.

items.statement: Destroy obsolete and outdated labels, labeling and other packaging materials.
items.quote: Obsolete and outdated labels, labeling, and other packaging materials shall be destroyed.

items.statement: Do not use gang-printed labeling for different drug products, or for different strengths or net contents of the same drug product, unless the labeling from gang-printed sheets is adequately differentiated by size, shape or color.
items.quote: Use of gang-printed labeling for different drug products, or different strengths or net contents of the same drug product, is prohibited unless the labeling from gang-printed sheets is adequately differentiated by size, shape, or color.
items.condition: unless adequately differentiated by size, shape, or color

items.statement: If cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons containing immediate containers not packed in individual unit cartons, include at least one special control procedure in packaging and labeling operations: dedicated lines per strength of each product, 100-percent electronic or electromechanical examination, 100-percent visual examination for hand-applied labeling, or an automated technique that physically prevents incorrect labeling.
items.quote: If cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons containing immediate containers that are not packaged in individual unit cartons, packaging and labeling operations shall include one of the following special control procedures:
items.condition: if cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons containing immediate containers not packaged in individual unit cartons

items.statement: Where cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons holding immediate containers not packed in individual unit cartons, one acceptable special control is dedicating labeling and packaging lines to each different strength of each different drug product.
items.quote: Dedication of labeling and packaging lines to each different strength of each different drug product;
items.condition: if cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons containing immediate containers not packaged in individual unit cartons; one of the listed controls

items.statement: Where cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons holding immediate containers not packed in individual unit cartons, one acceptable special control is using appropriate electronic or electromechanical equipment for a 100-percent examination for correct labeling during or after finishing operations.
items.quote: Use of appropriate electronic or electromechanical equipment to conduct a 100-percent examination for correct labeling during or after completion of finishing operations; or
items.condition: if cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons containing immediate containers not packaged in individual unit cartons; one of the listed controls

items.statement: Where cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons holding immediate containers not packed in individual unit cartons, one acceptable special control for hand-applied labeling is a 100-percent visual examination for correct labeling during or after finishing operations.
items.quote: Use of visual inspection to conduct a 100-percent examination for correct labeling during or after completion of finishing operations for hand-applied labeling.
items.condition: if cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons containing immediate containers not packaged in individual unit cartons; hand-applied labeling; one of the listed controls

items.statement: Where cut labeling is used and 100-percent visual examination of hand-applied labeling is the chosen special control, have the examination performed by one person and independently verified by a second person.
items.quote: Such examination shall be performed by one person and independently verified by a second person.
items.condition: cut labeling with visual 100-percent examination of hand-applied labeling

items.statement: Where cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons holding immediate containers not packed in individual unit cartons, one acceptable special control is any automated technique, including differentiation by label size and shape, that physically prevents incorrect labeling from being processed by labeling and packaging equipment.
items.quote: Use of any automated technique, including differentiation by labeling size and shape, that physically prevents incorrect labeling from being processed by labeling and packaging equipment.
items.condition: if cut labeling is used for immediate container labels, individual unit cartons, or multiunit cartons containing immediate containers not packaged in individual unit cartons; one of the listed controls

items.statement: Monitor printing devices on or associated with manufacturing lines that imprint labeling on the drug product unit label or case, to assure all imprinting conforms to the print specified in the batch production record.
items.quote: Printing devices on, or associated with, manufacturing lines used to imprint labeling upon the drug product unit label or case shall be monitored to assure that all imprinting conforms to the print specified in the batch production record.
